name: Orderly Parity
objective: Bring the Orderly integration to parity across order models, request building, sync flows, and UI while keeping TP/SL single-order-first with optional paired submission.
exit_criteria: Regular and algo Orderly orders are represented distinctly in models and parsing.
Stop, TP, and SL requests are sent with native Orderly payloads.
UI allows single TP or SL and optional paired TP+SL submission.
Websocket auth/subscription handling is more robust and algo events are consumed.
Funding, liquidation, and fee data prefer Orderly-native fields where practical.
Targeted tests cover request building, parsing, and UI-adjacent behavior updates.
Formatting, lint, types, and targeted tests run successfully.
